One Fast Cat ∙ AI Assistant
Hi there! Shopping for your cat? 🐱 Let us help you find the right fit to match their energy.
Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
Yes—an address change may be possible, but it is not guaranteed because orders are processed quickly.
Here’s the policy:
- One Fast Cat can update the shipping address until the shipping label has been created.
- After a label is created, any address correction is handled by UPS or FedEx.
- Carrier address changes after label creation require a $17 fee paid by the customer.
- Once the item is out for delivery, the address can no longer be changed.
- If the issue is a typo or missing apartment number, you can also ask the carrier to hold the package for pickup instead of changing the address.
Policy page: https://onefastcat.com/pages/order-changes-shipping-address-changes

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No. Once an order is placed, One Fast Cat says it is not possible to modify the items on the order in any way, including adding products, removing products, or changing color or quantity.
If your order has not shipped yet, they may be able to cancel it so you can place a new order with the extra item. The policy page is here: Order Changes & Shipping Address Changes.
